question: Anant Maheshwari, the President of ________ India, has been appointed as the Chairperson of Nasscom for the period 2023-24.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Microsoft**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anant Maheshwari** is the President of **Microsoft India**.
 
• He has been appointed as the Chairperson of **Nasscom** for the period 2023-24.
 
• Microsoft is a leading global technology company known for its software products, including the Windows operating system and the Office suite.
 
• Nasscom (National Association of Software and Service Companies) is a trade association of the Indian Information Technology (IT) and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nasscom was established in 1988 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• It serves as an intermediary between the Indian IT industry and the government, helping to shape policies and promote the growth of the sector.
 
• Anant Maheshwari has been with Microsoft since 2016 and has played a key role in driving the company's strategy and operations in India.
 
• Under his leadership, Microsoft India has focused on digital transformation, cloud adoption, and skill development initiatives.
